summary: OceanaGold filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 23, 2026 news release announcing that President and CEO Gerard Bond will retire in April 2027 after five years in the role. The board has retained Spencer Stuart to search internal and external candidates; Bond will serve as Special Advisor for six months post-departure. No terms, stake, price or premium are stated. The transition is planned, not abrupt, and should be orderly; watch successor identity and any strategy shift, plus ongoing Ausgold/Katanning integration.
